description: List every host seen for a domain (or IP address) across its newest scans, grouped by evidence: observed (the browser requested it) and scripts (a script the browser loaded) by default; declared (named in Content-Security-Policy, intent only), static (a URL in script source) and referenced (only a string or comment) on request in sources. subdomains_only keeps hosts below the domain. max_scans (1 to 1000, default 200) is how many scans to aggregate; limit (1 to 10000, default 500) caps hosts per source.

domain.description: Domain name such as example.com, or an IP address.
domain.title: Domain

limit.description: Maximum hosts per evidence kind, 1 to 10000 (default 500).
limit.title: Limit

max_scans.description: How many of the domain's newest scans to aggregate, 1 to 1000 (default 200).
max_scans.title: Max Scans

sources.description: Evidence kinds to include: observed and scripts by default; add declared (Content-Security-Policy), static (URLs in script source) or referenced (strings and comments only).
sources.title: Sources

subdomains_only.description: Return only hosts strictly below the domain.
subdomains_only.title: Subdomains Only

name: get_domain_hosts
title: Get Domain Hosts
